label: Bible Study
prompt: Her children arise up, and call her _____; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
verse: Her children arise up, and call her blessed; her husband also, and he praiseth her.
note: The virtuous woman's family review — five stars from the children and the husband.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: I _____ my God upon every remembrance of you,
verse: I thank my God upon every remembrance of you,
note: Paul, writing in chains, says every memory of the Philippians makes him thankful.

label: Sunday School
prompt: Let us make a little _____, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
verse: Let us make a little chamber, I pray thee, on the wall; and let us set for him there a bed, and a table, and a stool, and a candlestick: and it shall be, when he cometh to us, that he shall turn in thither.
note: The Shunammite couple built Elisha a little room on the wall: a bed, table, stool, and candlestick.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a _____ of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
verse: And I will give her her vineyards from thence, and the valley of Achor for a door of hope: and she shall sing there, as in the days of her youth, and as in the day when she came up out of the land of Egypt.
note: Achor means 'trouble' — the valley where Achan was judged becomes a doorway of hope.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: But when ye pray, use not vain _____, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
verse: But when ye pray, use not vain repetitions, as the heathen do: for they think that they shall be heard for their much speaking.
note: Jesus' warning just before the Lord's Prayer: God isn't impressed by 'vain repetitions' or word count.
